original_U_rule: Original unavailable always UNKNOWN; no replacement frame or coordinate adjustment.
consensus_candidate_rule: Same D or same E, both target_instance_identified=YES and intended_part_identified=YES; both query relation exactly agree ON or exactly agree NEAR; both location_error_possible=NO; both have nonempty short visual evidence; E additionally both have nonempty positive external_occluder_evidence.
separate_exclusion_rules: Either query OFF or location_error_possible YES -> LOCATION_ERROR_OR_OFF, preserving both states
Same D/E but any identification/relation/location/evidence requirement unmet -> INSUFFICIENT_ALIGNED_EVIDENCE
All other observations -> DISAGREEMENT_OR_UNRESOLVED; no adjudication by model score or protected data
independent_observers: A and C seal all48 own observations before root joins; neither reads other values in advance. Assistant SOURCE TRAIN weak only, not independent human raters or gold.
